definitions.explanation: Skin that splits from cold and dryness, usually on the fingers and backs of the hands, and may bleed.

examples.english: My hands get chapped and cracked in winter.

examples.japanese: {水仕事|みずしごと}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧あかぎれ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: Washing and housework gave me cracked skin.

examples.japanese: あかぎれ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}くて→痛い：01108_itai⟧、⟦{洗|あら}い{物|もの}→洗い物：08171_araimono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧たび⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦しかめて→しかめる：10351_shikameru⟧しまう。
examples.english: My cracked hands hurt so much that I wince every time I do the dishes.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- あかぎれ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧: to get cracked skin
- あかぎれ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{効|き}く→効く：01932_kiku⟧⟦クリーム→クリーム：00253_kuriimu⟧: a cream for cracked skin

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{肌荒|はだあ}れ→肌荒れ：08421_hadaare⟧: rough skin (milder, general)
- ひび: fine cracks in the skin; あかぎれ is the deeper, red, painful kind

WRITING:
- The kanji {皸|あかぎれ} is rare; the word is written in kana.
